description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, enabling configuration of Azure Table Storage-based reminder services within an Orleans silo host. It provides multiple overloads of the UseAzureTableReminderService method to set up reminder storage with different configuration approaches.

classes.name: AzureStorageReminderSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Azure Table Storage reminders.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Storage for reminders, with options for direct configuration, options builder, or connection string.
